prompts.q: change the data set to retail sales of electricity
prompts.check: () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#topic_select")].some((s) => /^retail sales/i.test(s.selectedOptions[0]?.text || "")) || /retail sales of electricity/i.test(document.querySelector("h1, h2, .chart-title, svg text")?.textContent || "") || /Retail sales of electricity, /i.test(document.body.innerText)

prompts.q: switch the table to annual and show it as a column chart
set the chart indexing to index to start as percent
change the data set to average retail price of electricity, then switch to quarterly
choose the report 1.14 net generation from wind by state by sector
turn on the relative standard errors checkbox
what was net generation from all fuels in july 2026
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/453,?744/].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }

prompts.q: which energy sources are shown in the chart
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/coal/i, /natural gas/i, /nuclear/i, /wind/i, /solar/i, /hydro/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 3; }

prompts.q: what units is net generation measured in
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/thousand megawatt[- ]?hours|thousand MWh/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }
